title: Synthesis of triazole-bonded chalcone derivatives from acetophenone
author: Ullah, Rohman, et al.

steps.title: Acidic aldol condensation
steps.instruction: In a 50 mL round‑bottom flask add acetophenone (20 mmol, 2.33 mL), the chosen aromatic aldehyde (20 mmol) and ethanol (2 mL); cool the mixture to 0 °C and stir for 5 min, then add concentrated HCl (5 mL) and stir at room temperature for 24 h. Quench by adding cold water (15 mL) and glacial acetic acid (15 mL), filter the precipitated solid, wash with cold water, dry, and purify by silica‑gel column chromatography using a hexane/ethyl acetate gradient from 10:1 to 1:1 to afford the hydroxy‑chalcone (2a or 2b).

substeps.instruction: Combine acetophenone, aromatic aldehyde, and ethanol; cool to 0 °C, stir 5 min.
Add concentrated HCl, stir 24 h at room temperature.
Quench with cold water and glacial acetic acid, filter solid.
Wash solid with cold water, dry, and chromatograph (hexane/EtOAc 10:1 → 1:1).

steps.title: Propargylation of hydroxychalcone
steps.instruction: In a 30 mL round‑bottom flask dissolve the hydroxy‑chalcone (5.0 mmol) in DMF (10 mL), add potassium carbonate (10.0 mmol, 1.39 g) and stir at room temperature for 1 h. Then add propargyl bromide (80 % in toluene, 10.0 mmol, 1.12 mL) and continue stirring at room temperature for 24 h. Pour the reaction mixture into cold water, filter the resulting solid, wash with cold water and dry to obtain the propargylated chalcone (3a or 3b).

substeps.instruction: Dissolve chalcone in DMF, add K2CO3, stir 1 h at RT.
Add propargyl bromide solution, stir 24 h at RT.
Quench in cold water, filter solid, wash, and dry.

steps.title: Copper-catalyzed azide‑alkyne cycloaddition
steps.instruction: In a 10 mL round‑bottom flask combine propargylated chalcone (0.5 mmol), the corresponding aromatic azide (0.5 mmol), ascorbic acid (0.20 mmol, 35.2 mg) and copper(II) sulfate pentahydrate (0.10 mmol, 25.0 mg) in a 1:1 mixture of DMF (2.5 mL) and water (2.5 mL). Stir the mixture at room temperature until the reaction is complete (monitor as needed). Pour the mixture into ice‑cold water, filter the solid product, wash thoroughly with water and dry to afford the 1,4‑triazole‑bonded chalcone derivatives (4ax‑4by).

substeps.instruction: Add chalcone, azide, ascorbic acid, and CuSO4·5H2O to DMF/water (1:1).
Stir at room temperature until completion.
Quench in ice‑cold water, filter, wash, and dry the product.

steps.title: DPPH radical scavenging assay
steps.instruction: Prepare a sample solution of the test compound at 500 ppm (2 mL) and a DPPH solution at 100 ppm (1 mL) in methanol. Mix the two solutions, homogenize, and incubate the mixture in the dark for 30 min. Measure the absorbance at 517 nm with a UV‑Vis spectrophotometer and calculate the inhibition relative to a blank.

substeps.instruction: Make 500 ppm sample (2 mL) and 100 ppm DPPH (1 mL) in methanol.
Combine, homogenize, and incubate 30 min in darkness.
Record absorbance at 517 nm and compare with blank.
